story_text:
## The 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine 2.0
A 100% 3D printable desktop pinball machine that you can print, build, and customize. STL files for 3D printing. Customizable | Modular | Expandable | Multiplayer
The 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine 2.0 is a desktop pinball machine you 3D print at home, assemble with printed threaded screws, and redesign as often as you like. Every flipper, ramp, spinner, and bumper comes off your 3D printer. No electronics, no wiring, no soldering. (The only things that aren’t 3D-printed are the steel balls, which you can still 3D-print if you want.)
The playfield is built from modular square tiles, so you can make it as small or as large as your desk allows, then swap attachments and rearrange the layout whenever you want a new game.
## 3D print your own modular, mechanical pinball machine. 100% 3D printed. Fully Modular. Any size.
Build It Any Size
Because the playfield is a tile grid, you choose the size. Start with a compact table that fits a small desk. Add a row when you want longer shots, a column when you want more room for attachments, and keep going until you have a full tabletop machine. Print tiles as you need them and bolt them on. The files are the same either way.
Multiplayer
Join two tables back to back and the game changes: each player defends a goal while trying to sink the ball in the other’s. Every table you build is also a multiplayer table. All it takes is a second set of flippers and the connecting tiles.
## How it works:
3D Print it. Build it. Play it. Rebuild it.
Back this project to get the STL files, print the pieces on your own 3D printer, and assemble a playfield that’s entirely yours. Rearrange it, redesign it, and challenge yourself, your family, or your friends to a game no one else has played.
Fully mechanical. Zero electronics.
No wiring, no soldering, no batteries. Every part is 3D printed, so if you have a printer, you have everything you need. Build your playfield your way, then lock each attachment in place with printed threaded screws.
## What’s New
We rebuilt everything from the ground up.
- Stronger playfield panels: New punch-tab design with heavy-duty mounting screws that hold firm, game after game.
- Locking threaded attachments: A new tight-fit thread system keeps every attachment securely in place, even during intense play.
- Truly modular: Swap, rearrange, and expand your playfield more easily than ever.
More modular. More attachments. More multiplayer. More fun.
Don't miss your chance to be a part of the launch and get the 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine 2 before anyone else.
## Kickstarter Reward Tiers:
In spring 2026, 1,580 backers funded the original 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine, raising more than 40 times its goal and earning Kickstarter’s Project We Love badge.
Over the months that followed, we watched what people built, and made a list of everything we wanted to improve. 2.0 is that list, built. Plus, Backers of the original pinball machine get a free upgrade to version 2.0.

## Development Timeline:
The original Pinball Machine was funded by 1,580 backers and named a Kickstarter Project We Love. 2.0 is rebuilt from the ground up: stronger panels, a locking thread system, and a fully modular tile layout.
## Suggested print settings:
Layer height: 0.28mm
Number of walls: 2
Infill: 10% support cubic infill
Material: PLA (matte or regular)
Minimum build volume required: 180x180x180mm
Suggested build volume: 256x256x256mm
Estimated material needed for 1 medium sized pinball machine: 2kg (2 standard sized spools)
Total time required to print 1 medium sized pinball machine: 20-30 hours
Do to the shear number of parts and user preferences, we cannot provide an slicer estimate for every part.
## Reviews:
## STL Files – Original Pinball Machine V1
5.0 ★ · 9 reviews
★★★★★ “I can not wait to put the entire thing together”
MrTroy
He has been looking forward to this project for a long time and can’t wait to assemble it. He expects a few days of printing and will fine-tune once it’s built.

Joseph B Abrams
Good fit across all parts, with very few print defects.
★★★★★ “Still printing but it’s coming together nicely!”
Todd Huish
It’s coming together well so far. The tolerances seem perfect and he has no complaints.
★★★★★ “Fun4All”
Michael Buch
A lot of fun.
★★★★★ “Printer settings”
Brad
He asks whether there are recommended printer settings.
## STL Files – XL Sized Pinball Machine V1
4.7 ★ · 10 reviews (7 five-star, 3 four-star; the page doesn’t show which reviews got which rating)
“Awesome with Issues”
JOSEPH Cataudella
He printed the XL after the Kickstarter, which took about four days on two printers. Everything fits together beautifully and the flippers are a highlight. His downsides:
- Playfield obstacles loosen over time from ball impacts, and some plastic screws snap off.
- The playfield still feels cramped at XL size.
- A ball smaller than 19mm might be easier on the parts, though the 19mm ball gives an authentic feel.
“Fantastic! Hope it continues to get support!”
JOSEPH Cataudella
His best and longest 3D printing project, and worth the wait. The threaded screws make assembly easy. He would like instructions for the add-on gadgets, plus lights, sound and better scoring in the future.
“So many thanks......”
Christopher Fugle
As a beginner, he found the instructions easy, and the small plate sizes work on basic printers. He finished in two days with three machines and loves the printed-bolt assembly. One minor issue is that the center base pieces lack matching threaded holes, but the underside bolts hold everything securely anyway. He hopes for expansion packs.
“Both XL and normal are enormous! Nice”
Mathieu Gervais
Both sizes are huge. A nice project.
“Great as a gift (for yourself, most probably ;-) )”
Jan Eijk
He’s printing it as a gift and likes that it’s modular, with parts that are easy to swap or replace. He wishes the extra attachments came with explanations, but it was worth every penny.
## CAD Files – Original and XL Pinball Machines V1
5.0 ★ · 2 reviews
★★★★★ “Great Idea and execution”
Johannes Wessely
A tabletop pinball machine is a great concept, and the execution is impressive. His first print over a weekend came out excellent.
★★★★★ “I’m enjoying the printing experience and the…”
Christopher Miner
He’s enjoying the print and loves being able to edit the CAD. A photo is attached to the review.

## A 3D Printer Academy Original Design
3D Printer Academy's Vision:
Unleashing creativity. Empowering individuals. Our mission is to inspire and educate hobbyists to explore the limitless potential of FDM 3D printing technology. We believe that everyone has the ability to create something truly unique and innovative, and we're here to provide the tools and resources to make it happen. Join our community and let's unlock your creativity with FDM 3D printing together.
## Why Launch the 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine on Kickstarter?
- Kickstarter has always had one clear mission: "to help bring creative ideas to life." (source: Kickstarter)
- the 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine is the ultimate creative project, which makes it a perfect fit for a Kickstarter launch.
- By launching on Kickstarter, we are able to reach more people, as well as determine the demand for the product.
FAQ: Isn't the design finished already? Why does this need a Kickstarter?
- We've finalized and printed the first working prototypes, but our work is far from done.
- Organizing, making building guides, and distributing STL files to 1000s of backers is no small task, especially with a project this big. Kickstarter give us time to accomplish this.
- We are also happy to take attachment suggestions from backers during the launch. So you can be part of making this project a reality.
Thank you for taking the time to check out our campaign. We hope you love the new V2 3D Printer Academy Pinball Machine as much as we do.
Happy printing,
3D Printer Academy Team
risks: We have successfully delivered all of our previous Kickstarter campaigns with satisfied backers every time. As a commitment to providing high-quality online 3D printable products, we offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee. If for any reason you are not completely satisfied with the course or product you purchased, you can request a full refund, and we will process it with no questions asked. This project is 100% digital and designed for 3D printing. 3D printers are not perfect and may produce parts with varying tolerances. Minor adjustments such as sanding, gluing, cutting, or scaling of 3D models may be required if your printer is not properly calibrated or differs greatly from our printers used in testing (Bambu Lab P1S). External factors may also affect print quality, such as poor filament, extreme heat, or high humidity. This is normal and expected with any 3D printing project.

faq.q: I backed V1 - STLs and/or Commercial License - how do I get the free upgrade to V2? Do I need to back this campaign?
faq.a:
You will automatically be upgraded after the Kickstarter campaign ends and will receive a new download link via email. 

You do not need to back this campaign if you backed V1, however your support is always appreciated.

faq.q: What material should we use to 3D print the pinball machine?
faq.a: We recommend either PLA or PETG. All of our prototypes were printed using Bambu Lab Matte PLA.

faq.q: How do we contact you for support questions, feedback, and suggestions?
faq.a: All support questions, feedback, and suggestions can be emailed to info@3dprinteracademy.com

faq.q: Will there be a place to share mods and user customization?
faq.a: No official 3D Printer Academy platform, but feel free to share mods and customizations online. We only ask of you to always link to the official Pinball Machine 2.0 product page on www.3dprinteracademy.com
